boundary: IEC supplies the liquid fuel skid inlet flange; EPC supplies counter-flange, gasket, bolts, the last pipe support and the joint.
contractor_side: IEC: liquid fuel skid inlet flange
isolation: EPC: LDO ESD valve (fail-closed) and manual valve with spectacle blind at the skid boundary. IEC: skid stop valve.
metering: EPC Coriolis meter on the forwarding skid (consumption and performance tests).
operating_conditions: LDO treated by the EPC to the GT inlet limits (ER-03.07); filtration 5 um.
protection: EPC forwarding pumps: discharge relief to tank set 12 barg (< 16 barg design).
